name: Cafe Eclipse
description: Cozy community-oriented cafe known for its welcome vibe and quality coffee. Live music every Friday 12-1. Also see Astro Flora on display through June!

name: El Bunker Cafecitos & Juguitos
description: Cafeteria Tropical • Bowls • Smoothies • Sandwiches • Açai • Ice Cream

name: Fuse Bistro — Cozy Downtown Lowell Eatery
description: Located in a converted firehouse in downtown Lowell, enjoy creative American fare, fresh seasonal ingredients, and dynamic menus.

name: Hive Public Market
description: Hive Public Market isn’t just a mall of retail shops, but a vibrant community space hosting music, arts, poetry, events, and a regular Artist & Farmer's Market. Home to Over the Spoon.

name: lala books
description: Best books in town! While you're there, support the Share the Love Book Drive.

name: Lowell General Store
description: Shop small with products from the best local brands of the Greater Lowell area.

name: Mira Ve - Colombian Street Food
description: Latina-owned Colombian street food restaurant serving up the real flavors of Colombia right here in Lowell!

name: One Urban Tribe - Local Shop
description: We carry a variety of locally sourced, handmade goods as well as some global selections.

name: Over the Spoon - Kitchen Store
description: Visit this store, located in the Hive Public Market, and fall in love with your kitchen.

name: Pop Cultured - Unique Pop Culture Finds
description: Located canalside, through the brick tunnel. Geek culture, MTG, gaming, collectibles, clothes, books, and costuming!

name: Simply Khmer Restaurant
description: Relaxed, unfussy restaurant offering an expansive menu of traditional Cambodian dishes. Vegetarian options. High chairs.

name: Warp and Weft - American Comfort Food
description: Pub grub served in a convivial, brick-lined eatery featuring craft beer on tap & regular live music. Brunch every Saturday and Sunday from 11AM until 3PM.
